new_results.statement: Any square matrix, not necessarily symmetric, whose 2x2 minors vanish whenever the two row indices and two column indices are four distinct coordinates is diagonal plus a matrix of rank at most three.

For symmetric M and nonzero ell, if Gamma_2=max_P ||ell_J||^2 e2(C_P C_P^T)=0 over all two-row original-coordinate splits, with C_P=M[P,J](I-P_ellJ), then M is diagonal plus rank at most five; the full scalar-completed residual matrix [[delta,ell^T],[ell,M]] is diagonal plus rank at most seven.

In the partner leakage branch W2>0, either Gamma_2>0 and ||p_Q||_infinity<=8.671392916 |a|^(-1/2) Gamma_2^(-1/12), with the identical signed-Fejer bound, or Gamma_2=0 and the residual Schur curvature is diagonal plus rank<=5.

averaged_frequency_transfer: When Gamma_2>0, the same 8.671392916 |a|^(-1/2) Gamma_2^(-1/12) bound holds for sup_{T>0,y} D_T by the account04/B01 signed-Fejer identity.
